title: Build a reusable component with @Input and @Output (or signal inputs) and OnPush change detection
hint: Use @Input and @Output with EventEmitter (or input() and output() signals), and set changeDetection to ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush.

title: Build a reactive form with a cross-field validator and an async validator (for example, username availability)
hint: Put a ValidatorFn on the FormGroup comparing two controls, and an AsyncValidatorFn on the username control returning an Observable of errors, ideally debounced.

title: Build a dynamic form with a FormArray that supports add and remove rows
hint: Use a FormArray of FormGroups, expose a getter, push a new group to add a row and call removeAt(index) to delete one.

title: Write a functional route guard that restricts a route by role and redirects to a login page
hint: Write a CanActivateFn that injects AuthService and Router, checks the user's role, and returns true or router.createUrlTree(['/login']).

title: Write an HTTP interceptor that attaches a token and handles 401 with a single token refresh for concurrent requests
hint: Use an HttpInterceptorFn that adds the Authorization header, and on 401 use a shared refresh observable (BehaviorSubject or shareReplay) with switchMap so concurrent requests wait for one refresh.

title: Build a counter and a derived value using signals, computed, and effect
hint: Create a signal for the count, a computed() for the derived value, and an effect() for side effects, updating with set() or update().

title: Write a unit test for a component that calls an API, using TestBed and HttpTestingController
hint: Configure TestBed with provideHttpClientTesting, inject HttpTestingController, trigger the component, then use expectOne(url).flush(data) and verify().
